authority: Scientist calculation-functions PDF supplied by the user; existing 14 November scientist-directed coverage policy preserved

preserved.cohort: Twelve completed sections; three distinct animals per condition per arm; same six animals across HK1 and PFKP
preserved.alignment: Unchanged prior fixed transforms; no refitting
preserved.positions: Full-precision bounding-box midpoint proxies, not measured centroids; no resampling
preserved.display_domain: Existing per-arm union of observed PLA/ChAT bins across its six sections
preserved.observed_support: Existing detected-object support maps are unchanged and are not tissue masks
preserved.coverage_wording_resolution: Page 1 refers to existing tissue masks and 100% coverage. Preserve the current mask-free domain and uncertain-coverage label agreed with the scientist on 14 November; do not invent masks or reopen the previous asset requirement.

area.units: µm² as labeled in the export; physical calibration not independently verified

intensity.units: Exported intensity units; physical scale and normalization undocumented

available_markers.label: ChAT
available_markers.population: Association flag on each PLA row

object_attributes.invalid_value_policy: Unavailable, malformed, nonfinite or negative required attributes invalidate their dependent section-bin measurement; invalid marker flags also invalidate dependent measurements. No silent object deletion.

measurements.per_section_definition: Count of PLA detections with area >= cutoff
Count of PLA detections with area < cutoff
Large PLA count divided by total PLA count
Arithmetic mean area of PLA detections
Arithmetic mean of exported PLA Average Intensity
Count of PLA detections with selected marker flag equal to 1
Marker-associated PLA count divided by total PLA count
Count of marker-associated PLA detections with area >= cutoff
Arithmetic mean area of marker-associated PLA detections
100 × bin PLA count / whole same-section PLA count
measurements.empty_bin: zero when the section has PLA; undefined if the entire section PLA total is zero

measurements.per_section_definition: Sum area of marker-associated PLA / sum area of all PLA in the section-bin
measurements.empty_bin: undefined when total PLA area is zero

measurements.per_section_definition: Type-7 linear median of PLA Average Intensity in a section-bin
Type-7 area percentile 75 minus percentile 25 in a section-bin
measurements.empty_bin: undefined without PLA; one object yields zero IQR

measurements.per_section_definition: Population area standard deviation (ddof=0) / mean area; at least two objects and positive mean
Per-object Euclidean distance to the nearest other PLA object in the same entire section, then mean of focal-object distances within each bin
measurements.empty_bin: undefined without focal PLA or when same-section neighbor is unavailable

order: Calculate the selected measurement per section and bin
Average defined section values equally within each condition and arm
Apply the selected comparison to the two condition means
section_and_condition_rules.empty_count_or_sum_bin: Assumed zero under current uncertain-coverage policy
section_and_condition_rules.no_associated_pla: Associated counts and associated fraction are zero when total PLA exists; associated mean area is undefined
section_and_condition_rules.condition_denominator: Number of finite defined section measurements, reported per condition/bin; three for complete-attribute count/sum calculations including empty-bin zeros
section_and_condition_rules.weighting: Equal weight per defined animal section; do not pool all objects across animals

comparisons.requires: Both R and H strictly positive

comparison_rules.R: Running condition mean of defined section measurements
comparison_rules.H: Homecage condition mean of defined section measurements
comparison_rules.color_scale: Shared across arms, symmetric and linear around zero for selected comparison
